_about: Example OpenClaw gateway config for the Launch Team agent group. Field names follow OpenClaw's documented agents/subagents configuration. Verify against your installed version: https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-agents and https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents

subagents._note: Pick a faster/cheaper model here if you run many specialists in parallel.

bindings._note: Bind only the orchestrator to a user-facing channel; it delegates to the specialists as sub-agents.

approvals._note: Enforce human approval in the tooling layer, not just in prompts. See shared/human-approval-policy.md. The keys below are illustrative — wire them to your actual tool gating.
